question: The image of the point (7, 8) when reflected along the x-axis is:
solution:
**Given:**

Point (7, 8) is to be reflected along the x-axis.

**Formula used:**

When a point (x, y) is reflected along the x-axis, its coordinates become (x, -y).

**Calculation:**

Original point = (7, 8)

After reflection along the x-axis, the new point is (7, -8).

**∴ The image of the point (7, 8) when reflected along the x-axis is (7, -8).**
